totals.predicate_scope: 420 successful-result checks plus 490 count/metadata/pixel/hash/saved-USD/invalid-input predicates, not 910 independent physics effects.

effects: New cameras report physical near/far .01m/1000m and corresponding meter/centimeter stage values.
128x128 and384x384 actual RTX images show red and green fixtures23cm away; moving red inside1cm clips it while green remains, and restoring it restores red pixels.
PNG dimensions/hash match returned metadata. Both saved stages per run independently reopen with standalone OpenUSD and preserve both clipping ranges.
Deliberate metersPerUnit=0 returns INVALID_STAGE_UNITS without creating camera prim or changing root, restoring original edit target.
limitations: Successful native RenderProduct/settings allocation changes anonymous root-layer text; no whole-root-preservation claim. Camera/geometry pack edits are session-authored. No user source files are involved.
Saved USDs were inspected in standalone OpenUSD, not fresh Kit camera-reuse qualification. Existing or reopened cameras are not silently changed by the creation fix.
RGB fixture cubes are horizontally cropped at image edges. Actual application viewport framing shows an entire red cube, a separate sampled visual. No physical movement claim.
Five windowed actual Console reviews retained, with warning counters separate from final whole-native logs. No warning suppression or blanket harmlessness claim.

First headless batch harness reported a stop/PID timing failure after 6.1 effects passed; later PID absence was established, and v2 uses bounded wait. First 6.2 desktop click omitted required dimensions and was refused by schema before input; corrected guarded click succeeded.
Prepared older installs and previously scoped locked6.2 install, diagnostic crash-upload-disabled bootstrap; not full installer/clean-machine qualification.

Does not resolve Newton6001 crashes, Newton601/61 NaN or collapsed-contact controls, ROS/Fabric black images, or original20f108-step stall. No independent agent task was newly performed for this focused fixture.
All ten owned PIDs absent following managed SIGINT; no force stop or unrelated-session intervention in this matrix. PR16/release remain draft and unmerged/unpublished.
